sources.title: Cheating During Testing [BETA]
sources.excerpt: Official Roblox page by @ebenxzy. Its description says players must finish tests before time expires without letting the teacher see them cheat. Completed tests award Credits, higher grades increase rewards, and players can buy cheating gadgets and equipment, manage Anxiety, watch for Snitches, team up with friends, and build a loadout.
